{
  "need": "Status",
  "secondary": { "name": "Belonging", "howItShows": "He wants to matter to this team but is going about it in a way that is actually pushing teammates away." },
  "read": "He is broadcasting his worth because he is not sure it is being seen. Showboating is a bid for recognition, not arrogance — he needs to feel like he counts, and right now celebration is the only tool he has found that confirms it.",
  "pull": { "collapse": "Enforcer", "instinct": "Call him out in front of everyone — cut the celebration mid-act, embarrass him into stopping — which publicly strips the very status he is fighting for and guarantees a power struggle or shutdown." },
  "mentorMove": "Give him a private moment where you name what you already see in him as a player, then hand him a bigger identity to grow into — the teammate whose skill lifts the whole group — so the standard feels like a promotion, not a punishment.",
  "holdFirm": ["The team culture standard holds: we celebrate together, not over opponents or teammates.", "That does not change regardless of how good the play was."],
  "stayFlexible": ["How he channels that energy is negotiable — a team signal, a chest-bump, whatever the group lands on.", "He gets input on what celebration looks like so it still carries some of his personality."],
  "forceLevel": { "level": 3, "label": "Collaboration" },
  "script": [
    { "phase": "Connection", "words": "Hey, walk with me a second. I want to talk to you player to player, not coach to kid." },
    { "phase": "Curiosity", "words": "When you make a play like that, what is going through your head in that moment? I am genuinely asking — I want to understand what you feel." },
    { "phase": "Collaboration", "words": "Here is what I am seeing from the outside. The plays are real — nobody is taking that from you. But I am watching your guys on the bench and the energy is leaking out instead of stacking up. You have enough pull on this team that how you celebrate teaches everybody else what we are about. That is a big seat to sit in. What do you think we do with that?" },
    { "phase": "Commitment", "words": "I am holding you to a higher bar than just making the play, because I have seen what you can do and I know you are capable of being the player who makes this whole unit believe in itself. That is a harder thing to be and it is worth more. I need you on that." }
  ],
  "longGame": "Once he owns a piece of the team's identity — the guy whose confidence is contagious rather than divisive — his need for status gets met through the group instead of against it, and that is a sustainable engine for both him and the culture."
}
situation: A player showboats after good plays and it is rubbing teammates the wrong way.
